title: ExtraResources
description: Adds technological and fantastical things to your world.
body: ExtraResources is technology mod that adds new items, structures, mobs, and more. Made using MCreator. If you find any bugs, please let me know in the comments! Future Plans: \- Add more dungeons \- Add another boss \- Add building blocks for creators     ![Review us on MMC Reviews](https://mmcreviews.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/mmcreview_banner_short.png)     If you enjoyed the mod, or had an issue with the mod that you want to address, please consider leaving a review here: [https://mmcreviews.com/all/mods/extraresources/](https://mmcreviews.com/all/mods/extraresources/)  This is important so that I know what to focus on, whether that be to add new content or bugfixing or revamping old things that need to be redone.
